name: Yesenia Maria Cuarenta
office: Paramount Unified School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 4

items.text: Yesenia Maria Cuarenta is a member of the Paramount Unified School District Board of Education, elected in 2018 and re-elected in 2022. She wrote policy to support the creation of the district’s Office of Equity, Diversity and Support Systems. She is a California School Board Association delegate.

sentences.text: Yesenia Maria Cuarenta is a member of the Paramount Unified School District Board of Education, elected in 2018 and re-elected in 2022.
She wrote policy to support the creation of the district’s Office of Equity, Diversity and Support Systems.
She is a California School Board Association delegate.

items.text: Her campaign says she voted against laying off teachers and support staff, and she supports equal opportunities for students regardless of immigration status. In 2024, she spoke at a board meeting in favor of special education teachers and proposed forming an Asian American Pacific Islander parent advisory group.
